topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I don’t rightly know what to make of all these old things up in the attic. Found ‘em when I was clearing out, looking to store some hay up there. Books and old clothes, and whatnot. Stinks of mildew and I fear it might bring sickness to the house. More than that, it feels wrong to have things that don’t belong here. They say these walls storied with secrets, but I’d rather they kept quiet. Best to burn what we can, I reckon, and sell the rest. Saints preserve us from the troubles of strangers left behind.
